variants.note: Short even turf with sparse rooted tufts and open low-contrast patches, suitable for a village green or grazed field.
Longer grouped grass at the field margin with warm dry tips, while the broad field centre remains quiet.
Darker turf at a bank or low hollow, with larger cool tufts and a restrained wet-earth transition.
